text: Yejin had a little lamb
Little lamb, little lamb
Yejin had a little lamb
Its fleece was white as snow!
Fluffy Yejin, fluffy lamb
Fluffy lamb, fluffy lamb
Two white puffballs, side by side
Who is who? We don't know!
They went hopping through the grass
Through the grass, through the grass
Hop hop hop and baa baa baa
Woof woof, here we go!
Pip came flapping, quack quack quack
Quack quack quack, quack quack quack
Three good friends all in a row
Splashing in the puddle, oh!
When it's time to have a nap
Have a nap, have a nap
Yejin hugs her little lamb
Night night, nice and slow
